sdk_source_refs: OCC surrogate: BOPAlgo_Options::SetFuzzyValue clamps fuzzy tolerance to Precision::Confusion
test_goal: Exercise primitive cylinder/wedge boolean across subtraction and intersection near exact contact and tolerance bands.
risk_summary: Source-level fuzzy/tolerance branches can make a near-tangent boolean report success while silently returning an empty, invalid, or topologically inconsistent result.

geometry.parameter_notes: Use exact contact, +/- geom_tol, +/- topo_tol, and one source literal tolerance if available.

expected_behavior: Subtraction should keep a valid non-empty target body; intersection should only become non-empty once the overlap is meaningful under the reviewed source tolerance.
notes: Prefer cluster_seed so the same source predicate can later grow generated-topology and large-coordinate siblings.
